obligations.title: Deliver monthly written SLA and Productivity Reports in the format the Client reasonably requires.
Record performance against agreed service levels in the monthly SLA and Productivity Reports.
Hold service review meetings at agreed regular intervals to review performance, risks and SLA and Productivity Reports.
Implement appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect personal data.
Return or securely delete all Client data and Confidential Information on expiry or termination and assist with transition.
Notify the Client in writing of the names of the Key Personnel.
